test_title: PYST 69: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The policy is supposed to have been drafted by external advisors in complete secrecy.

options.text: It was supposed that the advisors externally drafted the policy.
The policy drafting by external advisors was a secret assumption.
External advisors are supposed to have drafted the policy in complete secrecy.
Someone supposed that secrecy was used to draft the policy.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure for infinitives: The original sentence uses a passive reporting structure followed by a perfect passive infinitive ("to have been drafted").
 
• To change it to the active voice, the agent of the action ("external advisors") must become the main subject of the sentence.
 
• Keep the reporting verb consistent in tense, but adjust it to agree with the new plural subject: "is supposed" changes to "are supposed".
 
• Convert the perfect passive infinitive ("to have been drafted") into a perfect active infinitive ("to have drafted").
 
• The original subject of the sentence ("the policy") becomes the object of the active infinitive.
 
• Retain the adverbial phrase "in complete secrecy" at the end to preserve the full meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"External advisors are supposed to have drafted the policy in complete secrecy."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"It was supposed that the advisors externally drafted the policy." – Incorrect. This changes the tense of the reporting verb from present ("is supposed") to past ("was supposed") and changes the adjective "external" into an adverb ("externally").
 
• **Option 2: **"The policy drafting by external advisors was a secret assumption." – Incorrect. This completely alters the grammatical structure and phrasing of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4: **"Someone supposed that secrecy was used to draft the policy." – Incorrect. This changes the meaning, tense, and structure, removing the actual agent ("external advisors") from the action of drafting.
